Definition: from G2135; to castrate (figuratively, live unmarried):--make…eunuch.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, eunouchízō is the word for make…eunuch. In Matthew 19:12, the text says "For there are some eunuchs."
TheologicalSignificance: I read eunouchízō plainly — it means make…eunuch, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
